_about: 2-02, walking only. lift_789 runs on its own in the port (the backlog's G2: the original's idles
at marker a until a tap sends it), so this route waits for it: right onto it as it comes back
down on tick 274, standing still through the three carrancas' lanes on the way up, right off
at the top onto the bar and along to the door. Won on tick 528 (step 114). It rides the
self-running lift, so G2's step has to re-author it.
